what: The random test fails on some seeds, on main too: `a reparse whose errors are not the whole parse's`, the whole parse has `prefix `S` is unknown` and the reparse does not, after a `Rename` edit that puts an identifier right before a string literal. On 136432aa02 with HEGEL_TEST_CASES=4000 it failed (draws 399, [Rename { at: 768, to: 0 }], false); on this lane it failed once at the default 192 cases (draws 316, [Rename { at: 2816, to: 0 }], false) and looked like a regression of the lane.
cost: a base tree exported and built again to tell it from my change
cause: not found: an incremental reparse that does not relex across the edit's left edge, so a new unknown-prefix error at the token before it is missed (a guess from the two failures)
workaround: rerun; compare with main under HEGEL_TEST_CASES=4000
state: open: a real reparse bug the test finds only on some seeds; the test has no pinned failing case
